title: Dial.3 rem early
english: Rem early: proofs that the Son shares the Father’s Godhead without being a second principle. Worship, creation through him, and equality of glory are pressed against creature-talk.
translator_notes: Copy-text: PG 75 De sancta et consubstantiali Trinitate dialogi (CPG 5216).
True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Condensed lemma-led tip.
Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify. No Durand SC / modern English sync as base.

title: Dial.3 rem mid
